title: Multi-species long-read de novo assembly with StringTie3

manifest.description: Tab-separated batch run manifest, or assembled BAM/GTF manifest when run_mode is merge

run_mode.description: Run alignment/assembly batches or merge completed per-run assemblies

defer_merge.description: In batch mode, defer species-level merge and quantification until all waves are complete

reference_cache_dir.description: Persistent reference cache root; defaults to <outdir>/per_assembly
